title: Emergency rule for relocating fire-destroyed liquor licenses
summary: On September 9, 2026, the commission unanimously approved the seventh reauthorization of its emergency rule on relocating liquor licenses from premises destroyed in the August 2023 wildfires. The rule must return each time the governor's emergency proclamation is renewed. It lets an applicant ask for a hearing before the commission to make the case for using a relocation application.

timeline.text: The County issued a news release inviting the public to review proposed restructuring and amendments to the Liquor Commission rules. The amendments return to the commission's agenda on November 12, 2026.
